nodes.name: Compute Period (Month-to-Date)
nodes.notes: Report tabs always reflect month-to-date data (1st of current month through yesterday), refreshed on every run whether triggered weekly or monthly. This is a deliberate simplification vs. computing a separate strict calendar-week slice.

nodes.name: Compute Period (Last Full Month)
nodes.notes: Used only by the Monthly Trigger. Computes the full calendar month that just ended, so the closing report reflects complete, final numbers — not month-to-date of the new month.
